Founded in 2008, CSC Dumbrăvița played at the amateur level until 2018, when it promoted to the [[Liga III]]. The geographic positioning of Dumbrăvița, located near the city of [[Timișoara]], resulted in a 168% population growth between the 2002 and 2011, and subsequently led to a significant increase in the economic strength of the commune in the recent years. In the summer of 2022, the club achieved promotion for the first time to the Liga II. The team plays its home matches at the [[Stadionul Ștefan Dobay]], which is named after the [[Ștefan Dobay|most notable footballer]] born in Dumbrăvița."}}
